options.name: user
options.description: The user to teleport. Leave blank to teleport yourself.

options.name: system
options.description: The system to teleport to. Format namespace:system, or without namespace to assume endian.

options.name: body
options.description: The body to teleport to. Format namespace:body, or without namespace to assume endian.

options.name: x
options.description: The X coordinate on the body

options.name: y
options.description: The Y coordinate on the body

options.name: z
options.description: The Z coordinate on the body
